lines.zh: 我在雪地上走，蹄印是黑的。
lines.en: I walk the snow, and my hoofprints come out black.

lines.zh: 暗影顺着我的背滑下去。
lines.en: Shadow slides down the ridge of my back as I walk.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的毛会吞光。
lines.en: Do not come close; my wool swallows the light.

lines.zh: 苔原的风把我的影子吹歪。
lines.en: Tundra wind bends my shadow out of shape.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草色变深。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass comes out a shade darker.
Four hooves crack the thin ice under me.

lines.zh: 冷群系的夜，正适合我散步。
lines.en: A cold biome night suits my evening walk.
My horns barely catch any light at all.

lines.zh: 雪压在我背脊上，压成一层灰白。
lines.en: Snow lands on my back and refuses to melt.

lines.zh: 一群暗影牛慢慢挪向林线。
lines.en: The herd drifts slowly toward the treeline.
I lower my head and breathe out white mist.

lines.zh: 别数我们的蹄印，数不清。
lines.en: Do not count our hoofprints; you will lose track.
I circle half of the frozen lake, unhurried.

lines.zh: 脚步声闷得像盖着毯子。
lines.en: My steps land muffled, as if wrapped in a blanket.

lines.zh: 我踩过结霜的草，草就不响了。
lines.en: I cross frosted grass; it stops rustling.

lines.zh: 我领着小牛往背风处走。
lines.en: I lead the calf to the sheltered side.
I stand still, like a piece of the night.

lines.zh: 黑羊毛里藏着一点体温。
lines.en: A little warmth hides inside this black wool.

lines.zh: 风停了，我才听见自己喘气。
lines.en: The wind stops, and only then do I hear myself breathe.
I chew the dry grass buried under the snow.

lines.zh: 眼睛在暗处发一点红光。
lines.en: My eyes give off a faint red in the dark.

lines.zh: 谁在远处敲冰？我抬了抬头。
lines.en: Someone taps ice far off; I lift my head.
I do not shed this coat, not even in summer.
I flick my tail to chase off a snow bug.
Silence is the thing I say most often.
I smell grass roots somewhere beneath the snow.
My shadow turns slowly under my own feet.
I doze off leaning against a spruce trunk.
Do not stare too long; you will feel cold.

lines.zh: 牛铃没响，因为我没有铃。
lines.en: No cowbell rings, because I do not wear one.

lines.zh: 我把身子靠上冷杉，蹭掉雪。
lines.en: I lean on a spruce and rub off the snow.

lines.zh: 我在反刍，嘴里有一点点暖。
lines.en: I chew my cud; there is a little warmth.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不亮我的脸。
lines.en: Your torch does not manage to light up my face.
I am looking at the shears in your hand.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有光，我想借一点。
lines.en: There is light in your eyes; I would borrow some.

lines.zh: 靠近些，让我看清你的影子。
lines.en: Come closer, let me see the shape of your shadow.

lines.zh: 你为什么退后？我只是牛。
lines.en: Why step back? I am only a cow.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔横着，像两道缝。
lines.en: My pupils lie sideways, like two narrow slits.
You carry the smell of tanned leather about you.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，你也变暗了。
lines.en: While I watch you, you grow darker too.

lines.zh: 别举手，我不喜欢突然的动作。
lines.en: Do not raise your hand; I dislike sudden movements.

lines.zh: 你的脚正陷在我的影子里。
lines.en: Your boots have sunk into the pool of my shadow.

lines.zh: 我眨一次眼，雪就暗一瞬。
lines.en: I blink once, and the snow dims for a moment.

lines.zh: 认住这张脸，我会记住你。
lines.en: Remember this face; I will remember yours.
You cut off a tuft of my black wool.
The flesh stings, but the herd is waiting for me.
Blood seeps out from underneath the black wool.
One stifled noise escapes my throat.
Stop hitting me; I was only eating grass.
Someone in the herd turns to look.
That blow has knocked me off balance.

lines.zh: 你削走我半边的黑羊毛。
lines.en: You have cut away half of my black fleece.
I back away behind the calf.
Once the pain passes, I will remember.
Is that wheat? Hand it over to me.
I smell dried hay and my legs stop moving.
Stop swinging that grass; it makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 为了小麦，我可以走很远。
lines.en: For wheat, I would walk a very long way.
You have seeds in that pocket, do you not?
I lean in, and only because I want to eat.
The grass is under the snow; you are above it.

lines.zh: 我跟着那把小麦，走了三步。
lines.en: I have trailed that wheat for three whole steps.
Do not hold the wheat up so high.
My nose bumps against your hand, gently.
This smells far better than frozen grass.
I will follow quietly and make no fuss.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，能分我一口？
lines.en: Whatever is in your hand, may I have a bite?
My head is down; that means I am begging.

lines.zh: 你手里的小麦还带着光。
lines.en: The wheat in your hand still holds light.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，怕你被我的影子吓走。
lines.en: I approach slowly, lest my shadow scare you off.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你会沾上黑毛。
lines.en: Bump into me and you will pick up black wool.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你会知道牛有多沉。
lines.en: Hit me and learn just how heavy a cow is.
Do not shove; these horns do not watch where they go.
You bump me and the snow scatters everywhere.

lines.zh: 雪夜里我们肩挨着肩取暖。
lines.en: On snowy nights we warm each other shoulder to shoulder.
Step aside a little; I need to get through.
This coat will rub black all over your clothes.
Bone meets bone, and there is a dull thud.
My head stays down, and I will not shift an inch.
Mind the horns; they are harder than stone.

lines.zh: 两头暗影牛在雪里蹭鼻子。
lines.en: Two umbra cows rub noses in the snow.
Winter is long, so we stand closer.
I nudge its shoulder gently with my horn.
The herd is quiet, only breathing to be heard.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，影子叠在一起。
lines.en: We walk side by side, our shadows overlapping.
It blocks the north wind for me.

lines.zh: 雪地上两行蹄印并成一行。
lines.en: Two lines of hoofprints merge into one.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们在低声说话。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; we are talking very quietly.
When the calf is born, its wool comes out grey.

lines.zh: 我们不需要誓言，只要挤着。
lines.en: We need no vows, only to stand pressed together.

lines.zh: 我叼不起东西，嘴不合适。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; my mouth is wrong for it.
That tuft of black wool belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷起地上的草。
lines.en: I curl my tongue around the grass on the ground.
Do not drop wheat; I will step right on it.
Lower the shears, and only then will I come near.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅那东西，不是草。
lines.en: I sniff the thing; it is not grass.
That pile of wool fell off me; leave it.
You pick up yours; I will eat mine.
I lower my head to look for roots under the snow.

lines.zh: 东西落在我脚边，我没动。
lines.en: It fell by my hooves, and I did not move.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剪刀，我看见了。
lines.en: I have seen those shears in your hand.
Someone nears the herd, and I raise my head.
That smell... it is leather.

lines.zh: 你走得太直，冲我们来的。
lines.en: You walk too straight; you are coming for us.
I step in front of the calf.
The snow stops, and your footsteps become clear.
You count us; I am counting you.
Who touched the fence just now?
I turn my head toward that direction.
Do not think a cow cannot stare you down.
I hold your gaze and refuse to blink.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟一动，我的蹄子就跟。
lines.en: Your heel moves, and my hoof follows it.
The herd closes around me, keeping me in the middle.
I lower my head with the horns pointing forward.

lines.zh: 火光里，你的手腕在发抖。
lines.en: In the torchlight your wrist is trembling.
We do not chase; we simply wait.
Your shadow moves first, and then you follow.
Do not try to circle around behind me.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸压得很低很慢。
lines.en: I have pressed my breathing low and very slow.
Within ten paces, this ground is mine.
My horns go out, and the snow bursts apart.
I do not often gore people, but I can.
That was a warning, not an attempt to kill.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，雪没到脚踝。
lines.en: Two steps back, snow up to your ankles.
My hoof comes down and the ice splits.

lines.zh: 我一甩脖子，你就滚进雪里。
lines.en: One jerk of my neck and you roll into the snow.
There is your blood on my black wool now.
Do not come back for a second try.
I pant, white steam pouring from my nose.
Even a cow can hold a grudge.

lines.zh: 我从冷群系的雪里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the snow of a cold biome.
It is cold enough here, which suits me fine.
A herd of umbra cows walks onto the tundra.

lines.zh: 我的毛一出生就是黑的。
lines.en: My wool was black from the moment I was born.
Snow landed on my back, and I woke.
This forest is short one cow.
I crunch through a thin layer of frost.
The pines in the distance are shivering.
I smell the vapour rising off the frozen lake.
The herd spreads out, each to its own grass.
Fire catches my wool and it smells burnt.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，雪灌进耳朵。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope, snow in my ears.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进鼻子，我拼命蹬。
lines.en: Icy water fills my nose; I kick hard.
The blast rolls me over and into the drift.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩胛，我抖了一下。
lines.en: The arrow bites my shoulder blade and I shudder.
Purple light coils around my legs.

lines.zh: 雪下没有草，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: There is no grass under the snow, and I am starving.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的毛全立了。
lines.en: A bolt lands and every strand of wool rises.

lines.zh: 雪地不见了，我掉进黑里。
lines.en: The snowfield vanishes and I drop into black.
